run_list_top_hparams: run the CLI script to list top hyperparameters for a given algorithm, dataset, and test environment
run_load_and_filter_records: run the script to load sweep records from an input directory and filter by dataset and algorithm
run_hparams_accs: run a model selection method to get the best hyperparameters and their accuracies for each trial
run_todo_rename: run the todo_rename function to generate per-dataset and average accuracy tables across algorithms
run_print_accuracy_tables: run the script to print formatted accuracy tables with mean and error for each algorithm and dataset
